accessibility_checks: Each panel identifies its seed and rates.
Log y axes labeled relative one-step change.
alt_text: A two-by-two grid shows seeds 101 and 102 at equal learning rates 0.3 and 1.8. Each panel uses the final 512 saved weight states to plot 511 successive relative changes in the full weights, predictions on the frozen test inputs, and regularized training loss. Solid, dashed, and dotted lines identify the three readouts. These are post-run descriptive diagnostics, and all four tails remain unresolved under the frozen recurrence screen.
claim_scope_exclusions: No verified neural cycle or shrimp geometry claim.
No statistical generalization beyond these finite pilot tasks.

aggregation_and_transformation: Preset post-run display conditions: seeds 101/102 crossed with equal learning rates 0.3/1.8. All four existed and were unresolved; no replacement selection.
Loss relative step = abs(L_t-L_(t-1))/max(abs(L_(t-1)),1e-15). Training loss includes ridge.
Recompute predictions and loss only at saved states; no gradient updates or map advancement.
Dimensionless relative changes use separate denominators; equality of their values does not imply equality of task impact.
Exact zeros are masked on logarithmic axes and counted in the receipt.
data_source.exclusions: 158 other scan conditions are absent from this illustrative tail diagnostic but retained in the census map.
